books.name: A · FIB pullback @ flipped level (limit)
books.desc: BTC. 1h trend filter (EMA20/50). New 5m impulse leg >= 1.5x ATR5 in trend direction; a 0.5-0.786 fib must sit within 0.1% of a flipped level (15m/1h swing high and swing low within 0.1%, 14d, or PDH/PDL). Resting LIMIT at the level for 90 min; fills only if price trades through. Stop beyond the impulse origin (+max(0.05%, 0.2xATR5)). TP 1R, time stop 30 min. Best in-sample config from the 90-day backtest (IS +0.13R/21 trades, held-out -0.59R/4 trades).

books.name: B · FIB pullback + absorption (1m rejection)
books.desc: BTC. Same leg/level geometry as A, but no resting order: waits for a 1m candle that tags the level and closes back on the trend side AND shows absorption (aggressive taker flow AGAINST the trade on that bar from the live HL trades feed - sellers absorbed at support for longs, buyers at resistance for shorts). Enters at market on the next bar open (taker + 1bp). TP 1R, 30-min time stop.

books.name: C · Break & retest (15m swing / PDH-PDL)
books.desc: BTC. Break-and-retest: a 5m close beyond the nearest 15m swing / PDH-PDL (3d) in the 1h trend direction; limit back at the level +0.02% for 45 min; stop max(0.15%, 0.3xATR15) across. TP 1R, 30-min time stop.

books.name: D · Bank-heist alt scanner (top-5 volatile liquid HL perps)
books.desc: Top-5 most volatile (mean 1h range, last 24h) of the 15 most liquid HL perps (24h notional), re-ranked hourly, BTC excluded. FIB pullback at a flipped level (5m legs, 7d, 0.15% tol, stop beyond the level/0.886), limit entry. Slippage = 2bp + half the live spread. TP 1R, 30-min time stop, max 2 open at once.
